hero.title: About Petrosol
hero.text: Since 2005 we bring innovation and excellence to digitising the oil & gas industry. Together with partners we turn complexity into efficiency.

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.text: Founded in 2005 in Bucharest, Petrosol delivers end-to-end IT solutions for the oil industry and adjacent sectors. We combine deep technical expertise and domain knowledge to optimise operations and increase productivity.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Provide innovative, secure and scalable software that transforms how energy companies operate.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: Be the reference partner for oil & gas digitalisation in Central and Eastern Europe.

items.title: Innovation
items.text: Continuous R&D investment in relevant technologies.

items.title: Operational excellence
items.text: On-time, on-budget delivery with measurable outcomes.

team.title: Our Team
team.text: 50+ professionals (developers, system engineers, data analysts, consultants) deliver efficient implementations and ongoing support.

cards.title: Custom solutions
cards.text: We adapt the platform to specific processes and goals.
